template.description: Legacy field retained on import; the editor now uses fixed size levels and ignores this value.

theme.description: Legacy v1 field retained on import; use base.preset for the mounting background.

gap.description: Legacy import field. Current rendering ignores it and joins images without gaps.

columns.description: Legacy field retained on import; automatic fixed-level packing ignores this value.

src.description: Local PNG/JPEG/WebP path or a base64 image data URL. HTTP(S), SVG, and file:// are unsupported.

focusX.description: Legacy crop value retained for compatibility. Subject images are shown in full; background focus still controls cover cropping.

focusY.description: Legacy crop value retained for compatibility. Subject images are shown in full; background focus still controls cover cropping.

tileRatio.description: Web templates use portrait 2:3, landscape 3:2 or square 1:1. Native is the legacy/custom agent mode, not offered in the web editor.

crop.description: Explicit permission to crop individual sources to tileRatio. Otherwise incompatible ratios are rejected. Never clips the collage silhouette.

shape.description: Outline formed by whole rectangular images, without shape masks. Sparse collections have simpler stepped outlines.

granularity.description: Exactly 1–4 distinct image sizes in a fixed web template. Incompatible counts are unavailable; sizes are never continuously stretched. Native agent layouts retain their legacy height palette.

repeat.description: Allow reusing source images. Unlocks the same fixed capacities without changing selection. Fixed templates use the first min(count, sourceCount) sources; when reuse is needed all sources are balanced within one occurrence and dispersed.

count.description: Fixed mode: exact catalogue capacity, at most 200. Six stable options per family except geometrically restricted one-size rectangles. null chooses the largest capacity fitting available sources, or the smallest if none fits. Insufficient sources require repeat. Native mode retains the legacy 1-600 density budget; null uses 216 with repeat or all sources without repeat. Web imports map obsolete capacities to an available preset; all original source assets remain stored.

preset.description: none exports transparent PNG; ignores mat, shadow and background.

mat.description: Legacy fixed mounting margin, retained for older projects and CLI. The editor uses subject.scale to control whitespace and does not expose a mat slider.

src.description: Local PNG/JPEG/WebP path or a base64 image data URL. HTTP(S), SVG, and file:// are unsupported.
